R-Type DX.name: R-Type DX
R-Type DX.summary:
It's five games in one! R-Type I and II for Game Boy pocket, R-Type I and II color-enhanced for Game Boy Color, and the all-new R-Type DX for the Game Boy Color.

Tear through Bydo defenses as you blast enemies with your Fire Chain, Super Laser and Bubble Beam. Take the fight to a fevered pitch with two pulse-pounding rapid-fire modes on your Game Boy Color system.

Revelations - The Demon Slayer.name: Revelations: The Demon Slayer
Revelations - The Demon Slayer.summary: Revelations: The Demon Slayer is a role-playing game and the North American release of the Game Boy Color version of Megami Tensei Gaiden: Last Bible, the first entry in the Last Bible subseries of Megami Tensei. Based on the original 1992 Game Boy game, this version presents the adventure with color graphics while retaining its story and core gameplay.

Tweenies - Doodles' Bones.name: Tweenies Doodles' Bones
Tweenies - Doodles' Bones.summary: A game based on the BBC children's programme.
